title: Private Markets & CAIA
audience: Non-investment professionals, development partners and ecosystem actors
body: Distinguish yourself in the global asset and investment management industry by mastering the alternative investment landscape. The Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA) designation is the global benchmark for professionals navigating private equity, hedge funds, venture capital, real estate, and structured products. Developed for elite professionals, this self-paced, two-level curriculum equips you with the advanced analytical tools and ethical frameworks required to optimize modern institutional portfolios. You will join a network of over 14,000 charter-holders across more than 100 countries and 35 chapters, employed by leading investments firms globally and in Africa.
imageAlt: Participants at an investment education event

title: Islamic Finance & CIFE
body: This globally recognized, 100% online program bridges the gap between academic theory and real-world banking practice on Islamic Finance. Fully aligned with international AAOIFI Shariah standards, the curriculum equips you with an advanced, applied understanding of Islamic commercial banking, financial contracts, accounting, and Takaful (Islamic insurance).
modules: Islamic private equity and venture capital
cta: Apply Islamic Finance and get certified

title: Digital Assets & CDFP
body: Lead the future of financial services with the Certified Digital Finance Professional (CDFP) designation. This premier program equips you with the strategic frameworks and practical insights needed to master emerging tech, from blockchain and AI to mobile money ecosystems and regulatory tech (RegTech). Designed for forward-thinking professionals, the curriculum bridges the gap between traditional banking and cutting-edge fintech innovation.

title: Climate & Carbon Finance Academy
body:

• nature-based initiatives.

title: Impact Investing & AIMT
body: Drive sustainable economic growth by mastering the end-to-end process of deploying catalytic capital into SMEs and SGBs. Grounded in real-world case studies, this interactive curriculum equips you with the framework to navigate deal sourcing, due diligence, and exit strategies while embedding rigorous impact measurement and management. You will get a deeper understanding of global impact investing best practices complemented with local expertise and case studies. The AIMT builds on the global nature of impact investing and prepares you for success on an international and pan-African scale. The defunct ANDE’s IMT has trained over 400 IMT alumni in seven countries with over 15 training sessions. Asime Partners’ team has trained over 90 professionals over the past 4 years.
